answers.sql: SELECT (s_h.revenue_million - s_q.revenue_million) FROM services s_q JOIN services s_h ON s_q.entity = s_h.entity AND s_q.fiscal_year = s_h.fiscal_year WHERE s_q.entity = "Apple" AND s_q.fiscal_year = 2024 AND s_q.period = "Q2" AND s_h.entity = "Apple" AND s_h.fiscal_year = 2024 AND s_h.period = "H1"

SELECT (s_h.gross_profit_million - s_q.gross_profit_million) FROM services s_q JOIN services s_h ON s_q.entity = s_h.entity AND s_q.fiscal_year = s_h.fiscal_year WHERE s_q.entity = "Apple" AND s_q.fiscal_year = 2024 AND s_q.period = "Q2" AND s_h.entity = "Apple" AND s_h.fiscal_year = 2024 AND s_h.period = "H1"

SELECT (s_h.gross_profit_million - s_q.gross_profit_million) * 100.0 / (s_h.revenue_million - s_q.revenue_million) FROM services s_q JOIN services s_h ON s_q.entity = s_h.entity AND s_q.fiscal_year = s_h.fiscal_year WHERE s_q.entity = "Apple" AND s_q.fiscal_year = 2024 AND s_q.period = "Q2" AND s_h.entity = "Apple" AND s_h.fiscal_year = 2024 AND s_h.period = "H1"
